mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.3% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing liquidity for equity valuation and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.3% during the 2005-2024 period, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative equity returns as consumer spending weakens over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >50% of months where UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or the signal fails to outperform baseline returns in 3-year rolling t-tests (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >40% of instances where both HOUST < 1550 and RSAFS < 690000, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 5.0% combined with CPIAUCSL inflation above 5.0% annually indicates persistent inflationary pressure, triggering negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days as central banks prioritize rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >55% of periods meeting both thresholds, or the joint signal fails to show statistical significance (p > 0.05) in 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through sustained corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >45% of quarters where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions reduce corporate output and margins.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >50% of months where INDPRO < 100.0, or the signal's predictive power is insignificant (p > 0.05) in 2-year rolling t-tests.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market stress, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >45% of instances meeting both conditions, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in 4-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts decline below 1550 units during GDP growth above 3.0% indicates demand weakness in a strong economy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as sector-specific slowdowns emerge.
regime_hint: high GDP growth with housing weakness
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >55% of periods meeting both thresholds, or the signal fails to show consistent outperformance in 3-year rolling Rank IC comparisons.
